images.caption: Figure 1:Analysis of cognition-induced risks across three levels:physical cognition, where AI agents engage solely with environmental information;social cognition, where AI agents interact with other agents, including human and other AI agents; andself-referential cognition, where AI agents can represent their own states. Across these levels, the cognitive scopes gradually expand from a partial view of environment to a complete and self-inclusive world.

header: A Three-Level Framework Defined by Cognitive Scope
